test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "concept."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• "Concept" means an idea; a basic principle. (विचार; मूल सिद्घांत)
 
• In this sentence, **"concept"** is used to convey the idea that the understanding or abstract notion of money began to be comprehended and accepted by people over time.
 
• It suggests a mental grasp or awareness of the idea of money rather than its physical presence.
 
• The term** "concept"** fits well here as it captures the intangible nature of the understanding that gradually developed.
 
• Hence, the answer is option 1.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

........The **concept**__ of money finally took root in people's minds after many years. The usually erratic barter trade eventually gave way to the monetary method of exchange as such. At first, anything could be used such as hooks, money beads, shells or trinkets. The first gold coins were used as currency near Turkey, and each coin had a different denomination. In the kingdom of Lydia, the value of each coin was first standardised around 700 BC. However, as time passed, the idea of carrying a bulky coin pouch became less ______ (4) ______ because it attracted robbers......

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Belief: **a feeling that somebody/something is true, morally good or right, or that somebody/something really exists. (यह भावना कि कोई वस्तु या व्यक्ति नैतिक रूप से सही है, अथवा इसका अस्तित्व है; विश्‍वास, आस्‍था)
 
• **Notion: **something that you have in your mind; an idea. (मन में कोई बात, ख़याल; विचार, धारणा)
 
• **Opinion: **what you think about somebody/something. (सम्‍मति, राय)
